plan.text:
BUILD 13 PHYSICAL SUBSET PLAN — 2026-10-27, before test configuration, private edits or new physical instructions beyond low-level readiness.

Scope: one guided build13 guitar/audio + eight-switch/main-expression/local-LED + incoming-MIDI LED-feedback session in existing M3 (.3). Reuse the existing Guitar Rig 6 Cry Wah test setup and unchanged private monitor/feedback/status tools; no implementation, installation, mapping/calibration/LED-policy, NI timing/ring/calendar/clock/recovery/QoS or security change. SIP remains enabled. No new Bead. Build13 seven fresh silent stability/original-rate gates already passed; those remain separate evidence, not listening/control proof.

Before new test actions: verify frozen build13 source e61aa5ab / signed manifest 1f1ca4e6 against all12 actual installed hashes, signatures/Info and SIP; inspect sole owner/public-native health. Guitar Rig was selected for inspection and currently shows the existing 'RK3 Build12 Physical Test' Cry Wah preset with unsaved state, no version dialog; do not mistake its historical preset label for installed driver identity. Do not overwrite unrelated presets. Ask user to lower RK3 headphones before audible test; no unity standalone monitor or second audio client. Inspect Guitar Rig input/output RK3, 48k/128, routing input1->stereo output and enabled native MIDI source; change only necessary host test settings through UI, preserving original before/after settings. Reuse valid CC4 wah and CC80 switch1 assignments. If absent, restore only these host assignments with MIDI Learn (one bounded connection refresh if endpoint stale, with failure recorded); no driver changes or mapping invention.

Observers: one persistent native MIDI recorder until this physical session finishes, one read-only expected-rate native status watcher (48k), and one error/fault/timing log observer for the actual sole owner. Record argv/PIDs/logs/pins/start/end and cleanly stop/reap owned observers. No duplicate USB owner or standalone audio monitor. Start observers after final host rate/buffer configuration and retain throughout user checks. Expected native flags3/generation stable/error0 during Guitar Rig audio; stop affected test at first transport/health/clock/process fault or user-reported crackle/dropout/missed/phantom control. No retry/repair/security change/diagnostic expansion within this task; preserve evidence and report. User may take time; keep recording active rather than timing out their physical test.

Guided sequence: (1) low-level readiness, then 30s guitar listening in existing wah test rack. User raises headphone level gradually and reports clear normal-level audio, acceptable delay, no crackling/dropouts. (2) Verify wah follows expression and switch1 latches effect once per press, unchanged on release. If prior mappings work, no re-learning. (3) >=120s combined playing: from allLEDs off, switch1 wah on/sweep full heel-to-toe/back twice/off; switches2..8 each press/release twice, about1s held, LEDs on after first and off after second, no release toggle. Finish allLEDs off/heel. MIDI expected exact current switchCCs80,81,82,83,76,77,78,79, not80..87; expressionCC4 expected full0..127 from saved calibration. Record any extra intentional switch1 presses separately, never silently dismiss duplicates. Switches2..8 are MIDI/local-LED controls in this wah-only preset, not seven additional audible effects.

(4) With audio continuing and no pedal presses, send one known incoming feedback pattern LEDs1,3,5,7 on, others off through standard native MIDI destination; obtain physical confirmation. Then even pattern and confirmation. Then allLEDs off. These are deliberate feedback commands, not automatic Guitar Rig effect-state synchronization; no unsupported host-feedback claim. (5) Restore ordinary wah switch1/pedal operation after feedback: play, on/sweep/off and confirm allLEDs off/audio clear. MIDI last switch values/CC4 state and user result recorded. No mouse-driven host LED sync claim unless actual host sends states.

Finish: bounded observer SIGINT/reap with recorded exit policy (MIDI zero events exit1 only with valid zero final footer; real events exit0). Save final idle/running health and app state honestly; do not terminate user Guitar Rig unnecessarily, restore only owned test LED pattern to alloff and leave chosen host sample rate for use. Rehash installed bundles/signatures/SIP, capture compact physical evidence with exact user observations separately from recorded MIDI/status. Independent result review; update existing .3/.1/.2/parent as relevant but do not close wider milestones. No sleep/unplug/DIN/toe/external/gain/directmonitor/true-loopback/rollback or extra stability campaign in this subset. Remaining existing gates stay explicit. Export passive JSONL into active worktree only; preserve primary index blob113d42992a0ee90acfb640fc694b469abba536a6; commit/rebase/push Git and separately bd dolt push.

fresh_results.initial_listening: User confirms clear normal-level guitar and acceptable delay, no crackling/dropouts requested in question

preserved: No driver code, bundle, installation or security change. SIP enabled before and after.
No NI ring/calendar/timing/clock/recovery/QoS changes or new backend.
No host audio/MIDI setting or learn assignment change was needed; existing48k/128 setup reused. No preset overwrite or save.
No calibration or controller mapping/LED-policy change. Standard incoming MIDI commands deliberately set the local LED/state baseline for tests.
Pinned unchanged historical build12 diagnostic tools were reused against the exact installed build13 driver; no old driver/result is counted as fresh acceptance.
No standalone audio monitor, duplicate USB owner, extra stability campaign or new planning-only Bead.

Only the three owned observers were stopped/reaped, all exit0; user Guitar Rig left running at48k/128. Separate public readback client reports its own512-frame buffer and does not replace hostUI128 proof.
limits: Audio clarity, level, acceptable delay, audible wah, release behavior and physical LEDs are the user reports above; no PCM recording or true-loopback millisecond latency was measured.
The196.148194s interval is the observer/question window. Continuous actual playing duration was requested (>=120s) and confirmed by the user, not independently measured from an audio recording.

MIDI monitor records cumulative CC counts/extrema/latest values, not per-edge timestamps; exact2changes per2presses plus human release confirmation supports the latch check, not a measured per-event latency guarantee.
Only Cry Wah was mapped audibly in this reused test preset. Switches2..8 were verified as native MIDI/localLED controls, not seven additional audible effects.
Local latch LEDs and explicit incoming-MIDI feedback patterns passed. Automatic Guitar Rig mouse/preset/effect-state LED synchronization was not provided or claimed.

Read-only native status samples and the owner error/fault/timing log predicate found no watched fault; this is bounded observation, not absence of every unobserved internal event. No same-active-client clock API was instrumented in Guitar Rig.

This subset did not test last-output/input-only restart, sleep/wake, USB detach/reconnect, toe/external controls, DIN, gain/direct monitoring, true-loopback latency or rollback/reinstall. Wider existing M1/M2/M3 exits remain open.
